question: If the radius of a cylindrical tank is 7 m and its height is 9 m, then find the capacity of the tank (in m³ ). (Use π = 22/7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The capacity of a cylindrical tank is equivalent to its volume.

Volume = Base Area × Height = πr²h

V = (22/7) × 7 × 7 × 9

V = 22 × 7 × 9 = 154 × 9 = 1386 m³

**∴ The correct answer is 1386 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the cylindrical tank (r) = 7 m

Height of the cylindrical tank (h) = 9 m

**Formula Used:**

Capacity of Cylinder (Volume) = πr²h
